title: Keep chart series precision until display formatting
answers: Why do metric card totals change when I change Decimal places?
Why are pie totals or breakdown bucket sums wrong?
Where should SQL chart values be rounded?
body:
Invariant: Configured decimal places must not round numeric series before aggregation; preserve parsed precision, including percent scaling.
Enforcement: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:dataVisualizationLogic (yData selector) and frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/Components/seriesBreakdownLogic.ts:parseBreakdownSeriesValue parse values without decimal-place rounding.
Display boundary: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/Components/Charts/sqlLineGraphAdapter.ts:formatSqlSeriesValue applies display formatting; unstyled values use explicit decimal places or a default cap of 3.
Failure if skipped: Metric totals, averages and change badges, pie totals, and breakdown bucket sums operate on rounded inputs; two 0.49 rows must still aggregate to 0.98 with zero decimal places configured.
Constraints: This applies to numeric chart series and their aggregates; table cell display rounding remains separate.
applies: SQL chart series parsing, breakdown aggregation, and chart display formatting.
